description: This file defines the CliLoggerHandler class, which extends Monolog's StreamHandler to customize logging for command-line interface (CLI) environments, providing formatted output to stderr.

classes.name: CliLoggerHandler
classes.description: A custom logger handler for CLI applications, extending Monolog's StreamHandler to output formatted logs to stderr.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CLI logger handler with a specified log level, defaulting to DEBUG, setting the output to stderr and applying a custom formatter.
